Study.Metadata.Study.Name: Recovery Pathways EMA (branching example)
Study.Metadata.abstract: A 21-day ecological momentary assessment with morning, evening and weekly surveys. Built to exercise complex skip logic: multi-select questions that open several follow-ups, nested branches inside a conditional block, threshold (<=, >=) conditions, fail paths, and a question that routes into one of three mutually exclusive blocks. Responses are simulated and follow the same routing.
